text: The snow made things tight. After the meal, Ana and the child spoke of duties. Then the raid hit, a mess that ended. The shooting of that one man was bad, and there was much friction today.

text: The soft light is gone. The edges feel sharp now. I just want the next thing to be simple. A steady routine seems the only way forward. Kit and Lou sustained cuts from a shard. The ringing from the shot still lingers in my head. We saw the raiders arrive, and we named the east hill Widow's Rest.

name: Dee
text: The raid is over. I witnessed a shot taken, and the tending continues on those affected. Cy made a grab for the spare rifle from the armory. Need to check on Ana now.

name: Kit
text: A shard cut me today. The raid passed, which is a relief. I improved my intellect and finished a sculpture while speaking with Cy, Ana, and Bram. The structure seems to hold through this.

name: Lou
text: The shard cut still throbs a little. I got one piece of work finished. Then the raiders came. It is over now.

name: Max
text: Another piece is done, the rat bite is trivial. The midday meal was spent conversing with Dee. Later, the raiders came, and the raid finished. I just need to find the next thing to do.

name: Noa
text: The rat bite throbs behind the grime. After finishing the sculpture, the shared meal was quiet, though someone offered a passable compliment on the cooking. Raiders appeared, then vanished. The next task is what matters now.

name: Tam
text: The stars looked like seeds dropping tonight. I watched the two adults talk near the fire. At the meal, one said something nice to the cook. We sat around the pot.

name: Uma
text: The shared meal dragged on. There was talk of cooking and gathering around the pot. After that, there were some exchanges involving him and others.

name: Ana
text: You'll always have a warm plate at the end of the day, my friend.

name: Bram
text: Look. My share of this life I will keep for you.

name: Cy
text: Well, this is quite the celebration, hope the meal is good.

name: Dee
text: Enough. This is the Long Table, the Long Table.

name: Cy
text: Is this... the Long Table, Dee?

name: Ana
text: That's a hearty serving of sentiment, Dee.

name: Ana
